description: Tunnel chain check script, seed 1, one player, peaceful: the debug tools heap a soil hill 3.4 m tall over columns (15, 29) to (22, 40) south-east of the camp; then the four workers put up a Storehouse north of the hill at (17, 21) and, queued behind it, are given a tunnel chain clicked out from point to point with Dig, one order per stretch as the client sends them, level at ground height with the default 2.25 m roof: from the hill's west face at (15, 31) east 3 columns, south 3, south-east 2 and east 4, out of the hill's east side. Each stretch is 2 columns (90 cm) wide (3 on the diagonal, so walkers never squeeze past a corner); the workers dig them in turn with their starting digging sticks, 480 bites of soil giving 480 Earth, which they carry 5 at a time (25 lb) to the Storehouse and come back (Patch 4), and the last is finished by step 8200, each stretch a cave while it stays unlit. At step 8600 worker 1 walks to (19, 33), deep under the hill where only the tunnel leads, and at step 9300 on through the tunnel's corner and diagonal and out of the far side to (26, 37), on the tunnel's floor all the way. Columns are 45 cm, heights terrain units (11.25 cm); moves are world units (8,000 per metre); ids as of M11: workers are units 1 to 4.
